question: Does the frozen transformer's native block-5 causal Jacobian lens map through E to the independently learned pH action port B(x)?

protocol.latent: concatenated player/puck tokens after transformer block 5
protocol.readout: trained affine E(h) into canonical q,p plus hybrid modes
protocol.finiteTarget: centered pH step [Phi(x,+u)-Phi(x,-u)]/2 using the trained integrator
protocol.finiteObservation: write h5, render hard next frame, append it, re-extract h5, and apply E
controls: 16 latent direction pairs orthogonal to the lens
paired plus/minus writes with matched magnitude and model noise
protocol.confidenceIntervals: normal sample-level intervals conditional on one trained seed

lens.source: policy contexts disjoint from bridge evaluation
lens.method: mean downstream gradient of next soft player centroid

conclusion.text: The readout differential aligns with the learned port, but the bridge does not survive the finite render-and-reencode intervention.
conclusion.scope: Provisional within-seed conclusion. Sample-level confidence intervals do not quantify training-seed uncertainty.
